en.headline: Former HKTDC HR manager and sister convicted over undeclared family link in hiring
en.dek: The Independent Commission Against Corruption said the pair were found guilty of using documents to deceive the Trade Development Council and will be sentenced on 7 December.
body: A former Hong Kong Trade Development Council human resources manager and her sister were convicted on Monday of using documents to deceive their employer after the manager failed to declare that an applicant was her sister, the Independent Commission Against Corruption said.

Lau Yee-ying, 41, then a manager in the council’s human resources department, was found guilty of two counts of using a document with intent to deceive her principal. Her sister Lau Yee-lam, 33, then an assistant manager in events planning and customer service, was found guilty of one count of the same offence. Both charges are under section 9(3) of the Prevention of Bribery Ordinance.
The magistrate adjourned sentencing to 7 December for social service order reports. Both women were granted bail in the meantime.

According to the ICAC, Lau Yee-ying was one of the interviewers for an assistant manager post in late November 2023. She falsely declared she did not know the applicant, who was her sister, and later rated her as suitable for the job. The sister started work in January 2024 at a monthly salary of HK$32,000. In early 2024 both submitted outside interest declarations that falsely stated they had no relatives working at the council.

The council referred the complaint to the ICAC and cooperated fully with the investigation. The ICAC reminded public bodies to maintain clear conflict-of-interest guidelines and said officers must declare such conflicts promptly and truthfully.
Correction: the ordinance is the Prevention of Bribery Ordinance.

zh.headline: 貿發局前人力資源經理隱瞞親妹應徵關係 姊妹同被裁定罪成
zh.dek: 廉政公署指兩人被裁定使用文件意圖欺騙主事人罪名成立，案件押後至12月7日判刑。
body: 廉政公署表示，香港貿易發展局一名前人力資源經理及其妹妹，因在招聘過程中隱瞞親屬關係，星期一在東區裁判法院被裁定使用文件意圖欺騙主事人罪名成立。
41歲的廖綺瑩當時任職貿發局人力資源部經理，被裁定兩項違反《防止賄賁條例》第9(3)條的罪名成立；其33歲妹妹廖綺霖當時任職活動策劃及客戶服務組助理經理，被裁定一項相同罪名成立。
裁判官將案件押後至12月7日判刑，以待索取社會服務令報告，期間兩人獲准保釋。
廉署指出，廖綺瑩於2023年11月底擔任助理經理職位的面試官之一，向局方虛假申報並不認識應徵者，其後在評分表上評核對方為合適人選。妹妹於2024年1月入職，月薪3.2萬元。兩人其後提交的外間利益申報表均虛假申報沒有親屬在貿發局工作。
貿發局轉介投訴並全面配合調查。廉署提醒公共機構應制定清晰的利益衝突處理指引，公職人員遇到相關情況必須適時如實申報。
更正：條例名稱為《防止賄賁條例》。
